name: browser-use
headline: pptx: Automate PowerPoint Creation
short_description: The pptx skill for Claude Code automates the creation and manipulation of PowerPoint presentations. By streamlining this process, users can save significant time on presentation tasks, allowing for more focus on content quality.
author: anthropics

sections.overview:
The pptx skill is designed to simplify the process of creating and managing PowerPoint presentations through automation. It leverages Claude Code's capabilities to allow users to generate slides, format content, and manipulate existing presentations seamlessly. This skill is particularly beneficial for those who frequently create presentations, as it reduces the time spent on repetitive tasks, enabling users to focus on crafting compelling narratives. One of the key benefits of the pptx skill is its ability to save time. Instead of manually formatting slides or copying content, users can automate these processes, resulting in faster turnaround times for presentation creation. This is especially useful for professionals who need to produce high-quality presentations under tight deadlines. By integrating this skill into their workflows, users can achieve a more efficient and streamlined approach to presentation design. The pptx skill is ideal for developers, product managers, and AI practitioners who regularly work with presentations. Whether you are pitching a new product, reporting on project updates, or conducting training sessions, this skill can enhance your productivity. Practical use cases include generating a sales pitch deck from a set of data, creating training materials automatically from documentation, or quickly updating existing presentations with new information. Implementation of the pptx skill is straightforward, making it accessible even for those with limited coding experience. It fits seamlessly into AI-first workflows, allowing users to harness the power of AI automation in their daily tasks. By incorporating this skill, teams can enhance collaboration and ensure that their presentations are not only visually appealing but also data-driven and relevant.
Generate a comprehensive sales pitch deck from structured data inputs.
Create training materials by converting existing documentation into engaging slides.
Update presentation slides automatically with the latest project data and metrics.
Automate the formatting and design of multiple presentations to maintain brand consistency.
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills`
sections.usage:
```
Create a PowerPoint presentation with [NUMBER] slides about [TOPIC]. Include [ELEMENTS] such as charts, images, and speaker notes. Save the file as [FILENAME].pptx in the current directory.
```
Copy

```
I've created a PowerPoint presentation with 10 slides about 'The Impact of AI on Modern Businesses'. The presentation includes the following elements:

1. Title slide with the presentation title and your name
2. Agenda slide outlining the topics to be covered
3. Introduction slide with a brief overview of AI
4. Slide with a bar chart comparing AI adoption rates across industries
5. Slide with an image of a neural network and a brief explanation
6. Slide discussing the benefits of AI in business
7. Slide with a pie chart showing the distribution of AI use cases
8. Slide addressing the challenges and ethical considerations of AI
9. Slide with a world map image and a discussion on global AI trends
10. Conclusion slide summarizing the key points

Each slide has appropriate speaker notes to guide the presenter. The file has been saved as 'AI_Impact_Business.pptx' in the current directory.
```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
